description: Get a swap quote for exchanging tokens. Supports EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, BSC, Optimism, Avalanche) via Li.Fi and Solana via Jupiter.

amount.description: Amount to swap in human units (e.g. "0.5")

chain.description: Chain name (ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, bsc, optimism, avalanche, solana). Defaults to ethereum.

from_token.description: Source token symbol (e.g. ETH, SOL, USDC)

wallet_address.description: Wallet address to get executable transaction data (optional)

name: get_quote
